import sys
import random

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a = list(map(int, input[1:4]))
    b = list(map(int, input[4:7]))
    min_value = max(0, a[0] - b[0] - b[2]) + max(0, a[1] - b[0] - b[1]) + max(0, a[2] - b[1] - b[2])
    max_value = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])
    print(f"{min_value} {max_value}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def save_sort(array):
    shuffle(array)
    array.sort()

def shuffle(array):
    n = len(array)
    for i in range(n):
        j = i + random.randint(0, n - i - 1)
        array[i], array[j] = array[j], array[i]
    return array
